label: Nova: identify speakers
info:
# identify speakers

1. Open the Nova node and select an existing Nova connection, or add your API key to the included connection. Save and deploy.
2. Reopen the Nova node and choose a compatible model, then deploy again.
3. Set File in to an audio recording on the Node-RED server. In Docker, use a container path such as /data/recording.wav, not a Windows host path. File in returns a single Buffer. Click Identify speakers in recording. Read Who spoke when in the Debug sidebar.

Choose a conversation recording. Segments show speaker labels and timing, not real names.

The Full Nova result debug node is disabled by default; enable it to inspect msg.nova.response, status, and contentType. Catch shows errors and next actions. Nothing runs automatically on deploy. No API key is included.

name: Add connection → deploy → choose model if needed → deploy → click Inject. See flow Info for details.
